summary: Frontend-only test of the City Partners prospecting registry (/admin/city-partners and /admin/city-partners/:id), logged in as admin@propmanage.io, who has super-admin access. Passing: all 4 stat cards, all 9 status tabs, the category/country/zone filters and Resetează, the create form (every new field, 8 datalist categories, 11 status options, default status prospect), creating a profile with only a company name, editing (all new fields kept after a reload), the Fresh-r row, the detail page profile card, and the nepublic chip on non-active profiles. No console errors. Only minor issues and code-review points were found.

ui_bugs.issue: The origin '(neconfirmat)' marker only shows when p.country is set. Fresh-r has country=null, so its list row shows no origin marker, only 'acoperire neconfirmată'. Show e.g. 'Origine: neconfirmată' when country is empty.
When origin is empty, the line repeats itself: 'Origine neconfirmată (neconfirmat)'.

The detail page does not show the commercial status badge or the 'nepublic'/public indicator, so a prospect cannot be told apart from an active partner there. The green 'Creează cont CITY_PARTNER' button is shown prominently even for an uncontacted prospect. Suggest showing the status and nepublic badges, and hiding or disabling create-login unless the status is agreed or active.

issues: 'Început colaborare' uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar
Empty-state text says 'Adaugă partener' but the button is 'Adaugă furnizor'
There is no tab for status 'discussion' (Discuție inițiată). It is only reachable through the 'Prospecte' tab.

action_items: Detail page: show the status badge and the nepublic indicator; gate create-login for prospect statuses
List row: show an 'origine neconfirmată' marker when country is empty
Detail page: remove the duplicated 'neconfirmat' text
Optional: debounce the country/zone filter inputs (one request per keystroke, plus a possible race on out-of-order responses)
Optional: reset error state in load(). setError is never cleared, so one failed fetch leaves the error banner up permanently
critical_code_review_comments: CityPartnersPage.load() never clears error; once an error occurs it stays even after a successful refetch
Country and zone filters fire 2 API calls (list + stats) on every keystroke with no debounce or abort, so a slower earlier response can overwrite a later one
PartnerForm deletes an empty contact_email before PATCH, so an admin can never clear an existing email
Archiving inside a status-filtered view keeps the row visible with status 'Încetat' instead of removing it from the filtered list
Stats 'Prospecte' count is computed client-side from a hardcoded status list duplicated from the backend; use the backend's prospects grouping or the meta endpoint
